GraspNet-baseline, Scale-Balanced-Grasp and HGGD need no extra install. HGGD reads a colour image registered to the depth image as well; the others read depth alone.

<div class="gp-matrix" markdown>

| Method | Reads | Extra | Weights<br>from | Licence | Demo |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [GraspNet-baseline](../methods/graspnet_baseline.md) | depth | none | Google Drive | <span title="GraspNet-Baseline Software License Agreement (non-commercial research use only)">non-commercial</span> | 10.5 s |
| [GSNet](../methods/gsnet.md) | depth | `spconv` | Google Drive | <span title="academic, non-commercial (SJTU), as the reference repository; trained on GraspNet-1Billion (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)">non-commercial</span> | 14.8 s |
| [Scale-Balanced-Grasp](../methods/scale_balanced_grasp.md) | depth | none | Google Drive | <span title="as the upstream repository (MIT file; derived from non-commercial code)">MIT, with non-commercial parts</span> | 10.5 s |
| [EconomicGrasp](../methods/economicgrasp.md) | depth | `spconv` | GitHub release | <span title="MIT (the repository vendors operator code derived from a non-commercial project); trained on GraspNet-1Billion (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)">MIT, with non-commercial parts</span> | 14.0 s |
| [FineGrasp](../methods/finegrasp.md) | depth | `spconv` | Hugging Face | <span title="apache-2.0 on the model card; trained on GraspNet-1Billion, whose data and labels are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0">Apache-2.0</span> | 14.8 s |
| [HGGD](../methods/hggd.md) | RGB-D | none | Tsinghua Cloud | <span title="MIT (the upstream repository); trained on GraspNet-1Billion (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)">MIT</span> | 14.5 s |

</div>

- *Extra*: `spconv` is installed as the extra that matches your PyTorch: `spconv-cu118`, `spconv-cu121`, `spconv-cu124`, `spconv-cu126`, `spconv-cpu`.
- *Licence*: hover for the full text; each method page states it in full.
- *Demo* is the whole `grasppanda demo … --example` command, measured on one NVIDIA RTX A6000 shared with other jobs; no run was timed on a CPU.
- Every checkpoint was trained on GraspNet-1Billion, whose data and labels are under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
